papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.problem: Language models struggle with knowledge-intensive tasks that require access to external facts
papers.method: Dual-encoder dense retrieval with FAISS index feeding a generative model
contributions: RAG framework combining retrieval and generation
limitations: Requires large pretraining corpus for dense encoder
key_results: Improved factual accuracy over closed-book baselines on TriviaQA and NaturalQuestions

papers.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
papers.problem: BM25 sparse retrieval misses semantically relevant passages not sharing surface terms with the query
papers.method: Bi-encoder trained with in-batch negatives to produce dense passage representations
contributions: State-of-the-art retrieval precision on NaturalQuestions dev set
limitations: Requires supervised training data with gold passages
key_results: Top-20 passage retrieval accuracy of 79.4% on NaturalQuestions

papers.title: Augmenting Dense Retrieval with Sparse Signals for Robust Open-Domain QA
papers.problem: Dense retrievers underperform in low-resource settings where training data for the domain is limited
papers.method: Late fusion of BM25 sparse scores and dense retriever scores with learned interpolation weights
contributions: Hybrid sparse-dense retrieval with complementary signal
Robust performance in low-resource retrieval settings
limitations: Interpolation weights require tuning per domain
key_results: Outperforms dense-only retrieval on 4 of 5 benchmarks

papers.title: ITER-RETGEN: Iterative Retrieval Augmented by Generated Text
papers.problem: Single-pass retrieval cannot retrieve the full chain of evidence needed for multi-hop reasoning
papers.method: Iterative retrieval that uses the model's current generation to condition the next retrieval query
contributions: Iterative RAG loop with generation-conditioned retrieval
Improved multi-hop reasoning without retrieval supervision
limitations: Multiple retrieval passes increase inference latency
key_results: State-of-the-art on 2WikiMultiHopQA and MuSiQue multi-hop benchmarks
